permissions.read: View the permission catalog, permission groups and effective user permissions

users.read: View the user list and individual user profiles

users.update: Edit user profiles, status and own profile settings
users.manage: Manage user access: send activation invites, assign groups and individual rights

settings.read: View global settings: theme, locale and defaults for new accounts
settings.update: Change global settings and defaults for new accounts

storage.read: Download uploaded files such as avatars and attachments

integrations.read: View connected integrations, their status and the connection link
integrations.sync: Trigger a manual data sync with an external service such as Strava
integrations.delete: Disconnect an integration and revoke its access to user data

sessions.read: View coaching sessions, their messages and the streaming answer
sessions.create: Start a new coaching session with the AI coach
sessions.message: Send messages to the AI coach and receive answers

athletes.read: View the athlete profile and the latest calculated athlete state
athletes.create: Create an athlete profile and fill in the training input data

progress.read: View the progress snapshot: load, form and recovery trends

plans.read: View training plans, the mobile overview and manual plan previews
plans.create: Build a training plan manually or generate one automatically
plans.update: Regenerate a training plan and change its weeks and volume

workouts.read: View the workout list for a period and individual workouts
workouts.create: Create or log a workout manually
workouts.update: Complete a workout and record its actual result

training.analyze: Run a detailed AI analysis of a completed workout
training.adapt: Adapt the current training plan to the athlete state and recovery

account.update: Edit the own profile: first name, last name and locale
